title: Season missing
evidence: results_1960.json lines 193, 196-199
root_cause_hypothesis: Field dropped while copying a block of rows (all affected rows belong to one race block).
downstream_impact: Rows cannot be joined to races/circuits and silently vanish from per-season aggregates and model training sets.

title: Round missing
evidence: results_1960.json lines 193-195, 200-203
root_cause_hypothesis: Same corrupted block as B01 (1960 Italian GP).
downstream_impact: Race-level features (circuit, date) cannot be attached; orphaned facts in a star schema.

title: Car number missing
evidence: all 6 rows have positionText 'W' (withdrawn entries): {'W': 6}
root_cause_hypothesis: Structurally missing (not applicable): a withdrawn entry was never assigned a race number.
downstream_impact: None if handled as nullable; imputing a number would invent facts.

title: Disguised missing value: grid = 0 sentinel
evidence: 0 is not a grid slot; status of these rows: {'Withdrew': 164, 'Accident': 19, '+1 Lap': 18, 'Finished': 11}
root_cause_hypothesis: Source encodes 'pit-lane start / no grid slot' as 0 instead of null.
downstream_impact: Grid-vs-result models treat 0 as pole-better-than-pole; mean grid is biased low; correlation with finishing position is distorted.

title: Races with fewer entries than the season norm (2014+): verified, not data loss
evidence: 2014 R16: 21/22 entries, absent vs neighbouring rounds: ['jules_bianchi'] | 2014 R17: 18/22 entries, absent vs neighbouring rounds: ['chilton', 'ericsson', 'kobayashi'] | 2014 R18: 18/22 entries, absent vs neighbouring rounds: ['kobayashi', 'stevens'] | 2014 R19: 20/22 entries, absent vs neighbouring rounds: [] | 2015 R1: 18/20 entries, absent vs neighbouring rounds: ['alonso', 'merhi', 'stevens'] | 2024 R3: 19/20 entries, absent vs neighbouring rounds: ['bearman', 'sargeant'] | 2025 R9: 19/20 entries, absent vs neighbouring rounds: ['stroll']
root_cause_hypothesis: Each gap matches a documented real-world absence (e.g. Marussia/Caterham missing late 2014, Stroll injured for the 2025 Spanish GP), not a lost record. Should still be confirmed against the official FIA classification before publication.
downstream_impact: None if verified; shows why record-count anomaly detection needs domain verification before imputation.

title: Exact duplicate records
evidence: duplicated copies at results_1960.json lines 227-249
root_cause_hypothesis: A block of rows was appended twice (copy/paste or a re-run of an append-only load).
downstream_impact: Double-counts points and wins, inflates sample weight of one race, leaks identical rows across train/test splits.

title: Hidden duplicates masked by missing keys
evidence: rows results_1960.json lines 193-203 become exact copies of complete rows once season/round are restored
root_cause_hypothesis: The duplicated block of B06 was additionally damaged (keys blanked), so naive exact-match de-duplication misses it.
downstream_impact: Same as B06; also shows that cleaning order matters (repair keys before de-duplicating).

title: Natural-key collisions that are NOT errors (shared drives)
evidence: 83 driver-race groups; car number differs in 83/83; seasons 1950-1964
root_cause_hypothesis: Historic rule allowed a driver to take over a team-mate's car; each car is a separate classified entry.
downstream_impact: Naive de-duplication on (season, round, driver) would delete real history; the correct key includes the car number.

title: Identifier violates lowercase convention
evidence: values ['Cannoc', 'scott_Brown'] at results_1956.json line 134; results_1971.json line 242
root_cause_hypothesis: Manual edit of identifiers (mixed case) in the source.
downstream_impact: Case-sensitive joins with other F1 sources fail; the same driver can appear as two entities.

title: Incorrect storage types (integers stored as floats, dates stored as text)
evidence: season/round/number inferred as float64 because of missing values; date is an untyped string
root_cause_hypothesis: JSON nulls force numeric columns to float when loaded; no schema was enforced at ingestion.
downstream_impact: Keys like 1960.0 break joins and string IDs; dates cannot be used for time-based splits without parsing.

title: 'position' is filled for drivers who were not classified
evidence: positionText codes R/W/D: {'R': 9129, 'W': 358, 'D': 159} all carry a numeric 'position'
root_cause_hypothesis: Source semantics: 'position' is the order of finishing incl. retirements, not the official result.
downstream_impact: Analyses that treat 'position' as the result (e.g. grid-vs-finish regressions, the project dashboard) count a retirement as e.g. 18th place, biasing targets for prediction models.

title: Non-standard categorical values: free-text status
evidence: 136 distinct values; 122 values each <1% of rows; mixes finishing margin ('+1 Lap' to '+46 Laps', 'Lapped') with causes ('Engine', 'Accident')
root_cause_hypothesis: Status is recorded verbatim from race reports over 75 years without a controlled vocabulary.
downstream_impact: One-hot encoding creates 136 sparse features; reliability analyses (DNF causes) cannot be aggregated.

title: Contradiction: retired ('R') but status says lapped finish
root_cause_hypothesis: Driver was running at the flag but covered <90% distance (not classified); status and code disagree.
downstream_impact: DNF-rate features are inconsistent depending on which field is used.

title: Inconsistent text formatting (proper names stored in lowercase)
evidence: raceName, circuitName, locality and driver names are lowercase while constructor names keep proper case
root_cause_hypothesis: A normalisation step lowercased some tables during an earlier export.
downstream_impact: Cosmetic for models but reduces readability, breaks exact matching with external sources (e.g. Wikidata labels).

title: Points not comparable across eras (scoring rules changed)
evidence: points for a win range 4-50; the typical winner score changes in 7 seasons (1950: 9, 1951: 8, 1952: 9, 1953: 8, 1961: 9, 1991: 10, 2010: 25); 10 fractional values (shared drives / shared fastest lap, e.g. 8.14, 1.33)
root_cause_hypothesis: Not a recording error: FIA scoring systems changed (1950, 1960, 1961, 1991, 2003, 2010, 2014 double points, 2019 fastest lap).
downstream_impact: All-time rankings and models using raw points are dominated by the post-2010 era (25 points per win).

title: Statistical outliers that are valid (Indianapolis 500)
evidence: IQR upper fence 122.5 laps; flagged rows by race: {'indianapolis 500': 270}
root_cause_hypothesis: Indy 500 (200 laps, 1950-1960) counted for the championship under different rules.
downstream_impact: Removing them as 'outliers' would delete valid history; keeping them unflagged skews lap-based features.

title: Results that cannot be linked to a race
evidence: results_1960.json lines 193-203
root_cause_hypothesis: Consequence of B01/B02.
downstream_impact: Inner joins drop these rows silently; left joins create rows without circuit/date.

title: Duplicate race records
root_cause_hypothesis: Rows appended twice at the end of the file (rows 1174-1178).
downstream_impact: Join fan-out: every result of these races is duplicated after a join with races.

title: Duplicate circuits (exact copies and copies without ID)
evidence: exact copies: ['dijon', 'indianapolis']; ID missing but same url as existing circuit: ['circuit gilles villeneuve', 'losail international circuit']
root_cause_hypothesis: Circuits re-added during a merge without their key.
downstream_impact: Join fan-out on circuitId; a map aggregates the same circuit twice.

title: Same person under two identifiers
evidence: [{'driverId': 'arvid_lindblad', 'dateOfBirth': nan}, {'driverId': 'lindblad', 'dateOfBirth': '2007-08-08'}]
root_cause_hypothesis: A new driver was added twice by two ingestion runs with different ID conventions.
downstream_impact: Entity resolution error: career statistics split across two nodes in the graph.

title: Country names not in a standard vocabulary
evidence: {'USA': 13, 'UK': 4, 'UAE': 1, 'Korea': 1} (ambiguous: 'Korea'); nationalities are free-text demonyms incl. former states ('east german', 'rhodesian')
root_cause_hypothesis: Abbreviations typed by hand; no ISO 3166 codes in the source.
downstream_impact: Geo joins and choropleth maps fail (the dashboard map showed only 1 country); no interoperability.

title: Missing coordinates
evidence: ['madring']
root_cause_hypothesis: New 2026 venue added before its coordinates were published.
downstream_impact: Circuit cannot be placed on a map or used in distance features.

title: Missing attributes for newest entities
evidence: drivers: ['paul_aron', 'luke_browning', 'jak_crawford', 'ryo_hirakawa', 'ayumu_iwasa', 'arthur_leclerc', 'arvid_lindblad', 'lindblad', 'patricio_o_ward', 'cian_shields']; constructors: ['audi', 'cadillac']
root_cause_hypothesis: Timeliness: 2026 entrants/reserves were added before their profiles existed upstream.
downstream_impact: Age and nationality features are missing for recent drivers (none of them has a race result yet).

title: Reference calendar ahead of the results snapshot
evidence: 24 races of season 2026 without results; latest date 2026-12-06
root_cause_hypothesis: Calendar for the upcoming season is published before results exist; tables were exported at different times.
downstream_impact: Counting races per season or per circuit over-states 2026; an inner join hides the mismatch.

title: Mixed URL schemes (http vs https)
evidence: {'https': 1263, 'http': 1073} across all reference tables
root_cause_hypothesis: Links copied from different Wikipedia snapshots.
downstream_impact: Exact-match linking (e.g. to Wikidata) misses entities; mixed-content warnings in web apps.

title: Proper names stored in lowercase
evidence: e.g. 'carlo abate', 'circuit gilles villeneuve', 'montreal'; constructors use proper case ('McLaren')
root_cause_hypothesis: Same lowercasing step as B14.
downstream_impact: Readability and matching with external authority files.

title: Name differs from the official spelling
evidence: 'losail international circuit' while the Wikipedia/official name is 'Lusail International Circuit'
root_cause_hypothesis: Legacy transliteration kept from an older source.
downstream_impact: Text matching against official sources fails.

title: Mixed file formats in one package
evidence: 5 sprint files are pretty-printed JSON arrays while all other JSON files are JSON Lines; 3 non-data files (.DS_Store, empty .flag markers)
root_cause_hypothesis: Files produced by different scripts; macOS metadata zipped by accident.
downstream_impact: Generic loaders fail on part of the package; reproducibility depends on undocumented conventions.

title: Retirement causes no longer recorded in recent seasons
evidence: share of retirements stored only as 'Retired': 2019: 2%, 2020: 2%, 2021: 2%, 2022: 0%, 2023: 89%, 2024: 100%, 2025: 100% (found when the reliability trend was visualised in the project dashboard)
root_cause_hypothesis: Recording practice changed in the source from 2023: retirements are entered with the generic status 'Retired' instead of the cause (engine, accident, ...).
downstream_impact: Reliability trends and failure-cause models see a false collapse of mechanical failures and accidents after 2022; models trained across this boundary learn a spurious time effect.
cleaning_step: C07 (mapped to 'Retired (unspecified)'; cause analyses limited to earlier seasons)
